applicationProfile.reason: The ticket system requires server-side authoritative data for multi-user ticket sharing, company-based data isolation with authorization, automatic ticket assignment by category, email notification on completion, and cross-user statistics dashboards. These capabilities cannot be satisfied by browser-local storage.

supporting: Multi-user data sharing: ticket created by submitter, processed by handler in a different session (AC-01, AC-09, AC-10)
Company-based data isolation requires server-side authorization (AC-03)
Email notification on ticket completion requires backend service (AC-10)
Automatic ticket assignment by category to business groups requires server-side rules engine (AC-07)
Statistics dashboards aggregate across all tickets/companies/departments require server-side queries (AC-12, AC-13)
Operation logs require persistent server-side audit trail (AC-15)
Ticket transfer between business group members requires shared server-side state (AC-08)
